name: Databricks AI Agent
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Databricks AI Agent node to build an AI agent[^1] whose runs show up in MLflow Tracing in your Databricks workspace. The node runs the same agent as the AI Agent node: it takes the same chat model, memory, tool[^2], and output parser sub-nodes and offers the same options. What it adds is Export Traces to MLflow. With the option on, each run creates one trace in an MLflow experiment,...

parameters.name: Source for Prompt (User Message)
parameters.description: Where the user message comes from: Connected Chat Trigger Node or Define below. Works like the same field on the AI Agent node. The node doesn't offer the Connected Guardrails Node source

parameters.name: Require Specific Output Format
parameters.description: Turn on to connect an output parser sub-node that shapes the agent's output

parameters.name: Enable Fallback Model
parameters.description: Turn on to connect a second chat model that the agent uses when the main model fails

parameters.name: Export Traces to MLflow
parameters.description: Whether to send each run to MLflow Tracing in the workspace of the credential selected on this node. Turned off by default

parameters.name: Experiment
parameters.description: Where the traces are stored. Shown when Export Traces to MLflow is on

parameters.name: Automatically Passthrough Binary PDFs
parameters.description: Whether to pass binary PDF documents from the input to the model as part of the message. Turned off by default. Use it with a model that accepts PDF input

parameters.name: Batch Processing
parameters.description: Batch Size sets how many input items the agent processes at once (default 1), and Delay Between Batches waits the given number of milliseconds between batches (default 0). Use it to stay under the rate limit of a pay-per-token model service

options.name: Connected Chat Trigger Node
options.description: Looks for an input field called 'chatInput' that is coming from a directly connected Chat Trigger

options.name: Define below
options.description: Use an expression to reference data in previous nodes or enter static text

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: Connect an output parser on the canvas to specify the output format you require

parameters.name: fallbackNotice
parameters.displayName: Connect an additional language model on the canvas to use it as a fallback if the main model fails

parameters.name: exportTraces
parameters.description: Whether to send each run to MLflow Tracing in your Databricks workspace. Needs the Databricks credential above. Traces include prompts, model outputs and tool results.

parameters.name: experiment
parameters.description: Where traces are stored. Leave the name empty to create one for this workflow automatically.

options.name: systemMessage
options.description: The message that will be sent to the agent before the conversation starts

options.name: maxIterations
options.description: The maximum number of iterations the agent will run before stopping

options.name: returnIntermediateSteps
options.description: Whether or not the output should include intermediate steps the agent took

options.name: passthroughBinaryImages
options.description: Whether or not binary images should be automatically passed through to the agent as image type messages

options.name: passthroughBinaryPdfs
options.description: Whether or not binary PDF documents should be automatically passed through to the agent. Useful for models that natively support PDF input (e.g. Google Gemini).

options.name: tracingMetadata
options.description: Custom metadata added to tracing events

options.name: batching
options.description: Batch processing options for rate limiting

options.name: enableStreaming
options.description: Whether this agent will stream the response in real-time as it generates text
